Name: Tikvath, Father of Shallum
Summary: Tikvath, son of Hasrah, was the father of Shallum, keeper of the wardrobe and husband of Huldah the prophetess.
KeyStory: Tikvath is named only as the father of Shallum the son of Tikvath.
RelatedPeople: Shallum, Son of Tikvath; Hasrah, Father of Tikvath
LifeLesson: A wardrobe-keeper's line is traced two generations.
